text.en: Lava flows are the primary danger to human life during most volcanic eruptions, since lava is what people picture when they think of a volcano -- in reality, lava flows are typically slow enough that people can evacuate ahead of them, and the deadliest volcanic hazards are usually pyroclastic flows (too fast to outrun) and lahars (which can strike with little warning long after an eruption has visibly ended), not the lava itself.
text.et: Laavavoolud on peamine oht inimeludele enamiku vulkaanipurskete ajal, kuna laava on see, mida inimesed ette kujutavad, kui nad mõtlevad vulkaanile -- tegelikult on laavavoolud tavaliselt piisavalt aeglased, et inimesed saaksid nende ees evakueeruda, ning kõige surmavamad vulkaaniohud on tavaliselt pürolklastvoolud (liiga kiired, et neid ette joosta) ja laharid (mis võivad tabada väikese hoiatusega kaua pärast purske nähtavat lõppu), mitte laava ise.
